title: Killings at the river
summary: People who jumped into the river were killed by machine-gun fire from unnamed sadists; the passage does not identify Geshtapoviets Hoyn as the perpetrator.
uncertaintyNote: The text attributes the killings to unnamed sadists; linking them specifically to the named perpetrator is uncertain.
